translationRepairs: In the seventh year of Chongde under Taizong, the Dalai Lama and the Panchen presented tribute with a fresh translation of the scriptures.
In the seventh year of Chongde under Taizong, the Dalai Lama and the Panchen came through successive interpreters to present tribute.
The phrase 重譯來貢 describes tribute reaching court through successive interpreters; it does not mention scriptures or a newly made translation.
The territory has a monk known as the Dalai Lama, who lives at the Potala Temple in Lhasa and is called Front Tibet;
The territory has a monk known as the Dalai Lama, who lives at the Potala Temple in Lhasa; that region is called Front Tibet;
The coordinated description contrasts the Dalai Lama's seat in Lhasa with the Panchen Lama's seat in Shigatse; 前藏 names the former region, not the monk.
and the Panchen Lama, who resides at the Tashilhunpo Temple in Shigatse and is called Rear Tibet.
and the Panchen Lama, who resides at the Tashilhunpo Temple in Shigatse; that region is called Rear Tibet.
The parallel wording makes 後藏 the name of the region centered on the Panchen Lama's seat, not an alias of the Panchen Lama.
